response.sql: WITH signal_telescope AS (SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate FROM signal_telescope GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_pulse_rate FROM status_averages), filtered_first_round AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, (sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_pulse_rate) as excess_over_first FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN first_mean fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_pulse_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_pulse_rate FROM filtered_first_round), filtered_second_round AS (SELECT ffr.equipstatus, ffr.avg_pulse_rate, ffr.excess_over_first, (ffr.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_pulse_rate) as excess_over_second FROM filtered_first_round ffr CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE ffr.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_pulse_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as final_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_over_first) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(excess_over_second) as avg_excess_over_second FROM filtered_second_round
